The Moving Average indicator is a technical analysis tool that helps traders to determine the trend of a stock. The Fibonacci Retracement indicator is a technical analysis tool that helps traders to identify potential areas of support and resistance. It is calculated by drawing horizontal lines at specific percentages of a stock's previous high and low prices. The Bollinger Bands indicator is a volatility indicator that helps traders to identify when a stock is overbought or oversold. The Relative Strength Index (RSI) is a momentum indicator that helps traders to identify when a stock is overbought or oversold.
